sections.title: Your celebration, *our rooms*

image.alt: A private lounge upstairs with sofas, bookshelves and a dining table

body: Host your birthday, anniversary, rehearsal dinner or company gathering in one of our three spaces at 224 Upstairs: the Polo Lounge, the Jockey Club and the Veranda.

Enjoy a custom menu with boutique oysters, creative seafood dishes and chef-inspired land and sea options. We take care of every detail, so you can enjoy your occasion. We also cater weddings, receptions, corporate events and private celebrations, on site or off.

items.text: Great addition to downtown Aiken! The restaurant is cozy with comfortable booths and ample bar seating. We enjoyed the friendly service and outstanding food during our dinner there. The catfish and roasted oysters were fantastic.
They always have amazing and friendly service. The food is wonderful, with plenty of options. If you haven’t tried their shrimp avocado toast, it is a must have!
Excellent food, great service from friendly eating staff. I had a terrific seared tuna that I haven’t seen offered anywhere for a long time.

items.a: We recommend reserving ahead to get a great table. Call (803) 962-7848 to book.

items.q: Can you host a private party?
items.a: Yes, in one of our three rooms upstairs at 224: the Polo Lounge, the Jockey Club or the Veranda.
Yes: weddings and receptions, corporate events and private celebrations, on site or off.
Yes, gift cards can be bought online, and you can check a balance too.
